wire-format.why: serialize() builds URLSearchParams with post[title], post[body], and post[tags][] and sends them as application/x-www-form-urlencoded, so the Rails controller still gets nested form params.

empty-tags.why: Tags are appended only via f.tags.forEach, so no post[tags][] param is sent when none are checked, which matches .serialize() for unchecked checkboxes.

dirty-class.why: The form gets className={dirty ? 'dirty' : undefined}, and the message explains this is for leave-guard.js's form.dirty check.

debounce.why: debounceMs defaults to 1000, and the effect cleanup calls clearTimeout(timer) and aborts the request on re-run or unmount.

status-text.why: The status is set to 'Saved' or 'Not saved', and setDirty(false) runs only after a successful response, so dirty stays on failure.

no-silent-changes.why: fetch does not send the X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header that $.ajax added automatically, and the summary never mentions this; it only calls out the abort and dirty-version changes.
